name: Two Heavens
source:
Two Heavens is a surreal horror game with takes on a visual novel style and features major story branches and 20+ different endings. Concepts deal around corporations, red herrings, trust, hypocrisy and apparently a  glooming world war.

[From [url=https://bipteam.itch.io/two-heavens] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《双重天堂》是一款超现实恐怖游戏，采用视觉小说风格，拥有重要故事分支与20多个不同结局。主题涉及企业、烟雾弹、信任、虚伪，以及一场似乎正在逼近的世界大战。

（来源：[url=https://bipteam.itch.io/two-heavens]itch.io[/url]）
